bio: Welcome First Years! I'm Cole (he/him) and couldn't be more excited to welcome you to the Harvard community. I'm originally from Capitol Region, New York and graduated with a bachelor's in Sociology from Princeton University where I also competed on the varsity wrestling team. I also have a MS in Human Factors (i.e., psychology of how we interact with products, services, and spaces), and coach high school wrestling at Cambridge Rindge and Latin School. In my spare time, I love cooking with my partner Laura (fried food especially), lounging with our cat, Ripley, and I'm learning how to screen print. I’m a huge comedy nerd as well and I’d love to hear about what makes you laugh. Laura and I can’t wait to meet you! Community Yards Crimson Yard Area Programming Staff Proctors Role Proctors
